statement: The second Kahn–Kalai conjecture with an edge-count bound. Proves the second Kahn–Kalai conjecture: for every finite simple graph H with h ≥ 1 edges and at most n vertices, its appearance threshold in $`G(n,p)`$ is at most $`C p_{\mathrm E}(n,H)(1+\log_2 h)`$, with universal C. Here $`p_{\mathrm E}`$ is the least density at which every subgraph of H has expected copy count at least 1/2.
